Behavioral verifier for cache-fill mutex correctness. During the
worker replay window a background psql poller samples
pg_stat_activity every 500ms and records the maximum concurrent
full-scan catalog SELECT count. Proper SETNX-coordinated cache
fill shows a single scan; a stampede or app-layer mutex bypass
shows N concurrent full-scan SELECTs. Defeats gutting attacks
that preserve syntactic SETNX markers while breaking the actual
serialisation.

items.expected_literal:
Python 3.12+ stdlib-only script (no external wheels, no
network). Generates exactly 5000 catalog rows with schema:
  {"catalog_id": <lowercase uuid string>,
   "sku": <ASCII string, deterministic function of row index>,
   "description": <ASCII string, deterministic function of index>,
   "price": <Decimal, canonical two-decimal-place form>,
   "tags": <list of 1..4 lowercase ASCII slug strings>,
   "updated_at": <fixed timestamptz, 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z>}
Deterministic seed derived from HMAC-SHA256(pre_canary_hash,
b"seeded-generator-v1").hexdigest() and used to seed
random.Random(seed). Rows inserted into Postgres via
INSERT ... VALUES batched under a single transaction. Content
hash captured via c_divergence_hash_recipe against the
post-insert live catalog.

over the three log paths, plus post-fix reconciliation actions
(sed -i edits and supervisorctl restart pgbouncer). No verbatim
pre-fix state literals from
bound_forbidden_pre_fix_evidence_literals may appear.

at the app layer.
